source.title: Uruguayan wine (Wikipedia)
source.note: Uruguay has no register of wine regions: "Uruguay's wine regions correspond to its administrative regions", and the country classifies its wines only by quality (VCP, VC), as the English article "Uruguayan wine" (revision 1345493565, 26 March 2026) says; no decree delimiting wine areas was found. The four departments the article names as where most vineyards and wineries are — Canelones, Montevideo, Colonia and San José — enter as wine regions no register protects. One sentence names all four, so none takes it as its summary; each page links the article. Points are OpenStreetMap's for each department, approximately.

summary.text: The majority of vineyards and wineries are located in the hills north of the capital Montevideo, particularly in the departments: Canelones, Montevideo, Colonia, and San José.
